target_theorems.input: Untrusted wire bytes plus an independently supplied environment/context containing the pinned interpretation/profile/schema/hash and signature policies, expected project/release/role/source scope, authenticated trust store, original-artifact access, authenticated current-state evidence, authorized private mapping where required, observation time and resource budgets.
target_theorems.output: A structured decision record naming the exact validated payload and digests, all eight manuscript findings with evidence/reasons, exact verifier/policy versions, cache age where relevant, and lifecycle/verdict state.
target_theorems.soundness: For every context and wire, if the concrete implementation returns ACCEPT for a target, there exists one payload parsed and validated from that wire; its canonical bytes and framed message are exact, its signature matches the selected acceptance predicate, its key/scope are independently authorized, both commitments reproduce, required current-source/freshness/private-linkage predicates hold, and the output findings refer to that same target under that same context.
target_theorems.completeness: For every valid wire/context with all required evidence available, if every selected specification acceptance condition holds and no applicable revocation/conflict/resource failure exists, the implementation returns ACCEPT for that target. Unavailable required evidence must produce an explicit incomplete result.
target_theorems.refinement: A proof-carrying map from the actual implementation state/transition semantics to the exact abstract protocol preserves initialization and every step or declared stutter; the abstract safety invariants imply accepted outputs are sound and unauthorized/replayed/conflicting/invalid inputs never gain acceptance.
target_theorems.resource_behavior: For bounded inputs the implementation terminates within the selected model's resource semantics or returns a specified incomplete/error result without manufacturing pass evidence.
target_theorems.cryptographic_authenticity: Any computational claim that acceptance implies signer-origin or collision-free commitment association must identify a probabilistic adversary/game and explicit hardness assumptions. Deterministic verification correctness alone does not prove unforgeability or provenance.
target_theorems.scope_limit: Formal protocol correctness cannot prove the signer's scientific/attribution statement true, legal identity, live deployment or actual source availability from self-reported flags.

obligations.title: Pin one complete interpretation and profile
obligations.precise_goal: Define the exact specification objects consumed by run: governing source/import closure, closed schema, source/hash-profile registry, signature-policy predicate, trust/revision/private-resolution policy, bounds and lifecycle semantics. Prove all references resolve uniquely to these pinned objects.
obligations.gap: Recovered definitions are generic. Candidate16KiB/depth8 and older1MiB/depth64 profiles are distinct; the manuscript's signature-policy proposal remains NOT ADOPTED.
obligations.next_action: Materialize an exact public specification packet and dependency manifest for one target edition. Candidate correctness can be proved for explicitly fixed parameters without claiming operational adoption.

obligations.title: Recover and verify exact intended Lean dependency closure
obligations.precise_goal: Hash-bind every imported source/compiled module, Std/compiler version and axiom audit to the exact proof target; compile the whole graph at trust0; match all declared theorem names to audits; prove final witnesses are from this graph.
obligations.gap: Distinct4.24.0 corrected core/pair-wire/structural packages are incompletely recovered. Matching names or historical counts cannot replace exact sources.
obligations.next_action: Recover the original pair-wire engineering ZIP and exact AppendixQ packets; verify identities before compiling with native pinned4.24.0. Do not substitute4.22 namespaces or synthesize missing imports.

obligations.title: Actual strict intake and closed schema
obligations.precise_goal: Prove actual parseStrict/validate soundness and completeness for UTF8, decoded Unicode, duplicate detection before discard, exact nested key sets/types, source-order constraints, revision bounds, predecessor/null rules, approved identifiers and stated limits.
obligations.gap: ParserProfile supplies arbitrary parses/occurrences functions. UTF8 boundary delegates String.fromUTF8? and does not prove full JSON escaping, JCS or implementation behavior; partial4.24 key/array/structure sources are missing.
obligations.next_action: Implement or recover one concrete bounded parser and validators, define their grammar/semantics and prove rejection/acceptance correspondence before composing with the gate.

obligations.title: Preserve all eight semantic findings
obligations.precise_goal: Specify and prove attribution-map validity separately from schema validity, then define a proved mapping from the concrete eight-finding decision record to any abstract gate model; prove no required finding is dropped or silently folded.
obligations.gap: Manuscript§6 names eight findings. Recovered VerificationReport has seven fields and no separate attribution-map field. Gate equivalence is therefore not yet correspondence to the full manuscript result schema.
obligations.next_action: Extend a successor model or provide an explicit justified embedding with a proved attribution invariant; preserve existing frozen source and signed delivery.

obligations.title: Concrete ordered-pair recovery and association
obligations.precise_goal: For actual source A/B input and record construction, prove the source order, identifiers and commitment/attribution fields refer to the same ordered pair. Use an order-preserving representation; prove exact roundtrip/canonical accepted-wire converse.
obligations.gap: The extensional extraction set loses order and duplicate multiplicity. Exact PairWireRecovery direct imports are absent. Its candidate typed pair codec does not instantiate actual NCPS JSON/payload semantics.
obligations.next_action: Recover ParserRefinement and PairExtraction closure, compile the exact concrete recovery unit, and add a separately proved bridge from that codec to the chosen signed record field semantics.

obligations.title: Exact canonical record bytes
obligations.precise_goal: Instantiate the actual record codec and prove C=UTF8(JCS(payload)) exactly, canonical roundtrip and uniqueness on allowed payloads, UTF16 key ordering, array/string preservation, number behavior and absence of BOM/trailing newline.
obligations.gap: Generic RoundTrip is an explicit premise. The only concrete recovered codec is an illustrative leading-tag binary SampleRecord, explicitly not JCS.
obligations.next_action: Prove a concrete bounded JCS implementation against exact selected value/scalar semantics, or integrate an independently established formal implementation with a proved adapter. Finite fixtures supplement but do not establish universal correspondence.

obligations.title: Exact pure-Ed25519 signed message
obligations.precise_goal: Prove M=ASCII(NUMINA-PAIR-BINDING/V1)||0x00||C, with the22ASCII-byte literal plus one separator, no extra bytes and pure Ed25519 rather than application prehash/Ed25519ctx.
obligations.gap: Fixed-tag generic injectivity is proved; exact concrete payload codec/literal-to-runtime preimage bridge remains unproved. Fixed-tag injectivity does not establish separation across arbitrary different byte tags; any cross-protocol tag-registry uniqueness/separator constraints require their own specification and proof.
obligations.next_action: Instantiate the literal bytes and concrete codec, prove executable preimage equality and provider-call message identity, then add byte-level positive/tamper/cross-domain regression vectors.

obligations.title: Verification acceptance predicate and implementation correspondence
obligations.precise_goal: Define exact raw-key/signature decoding, canonical scalar/point rules, small-order/subgroup/cofactor handling and signature equation; prove concrete provider/native verifier returns true iff the selected mathematical predicate holds on the exact M.
obligations.gap: No recovered Lean module implements Ed25519 verification or proves provider correspondence. Policy remains a NOT ADOPTED proposal, and observed165provider disagreements/finite919case comparisons expose that provider naming alone is insufficient.
obligations.next_action: Fix the predicate and pinned adapter, recover policy/corpus bytes, reconcile every negative/edge expectation and obtain a proof or a separately documented trusted implementation boundary. Do not replace the missing proof with a custom axiom.

obligations.title: Independent key, role and scope authorization
obligations.precise_goal: Prove accepted key_id matches the raw-key fingerprint under the selected profile and the authenticated trust entry permits exact project/release/source/role at the selected validity/revocation times; reject out-of-scope keys even with valid signatures.
obligations.gap: Current theorems project or reject modeled flags; no concrete authenticated trust-store resolver or authorization semantics is instantiated.
obligations.next_action: Define trusted-input authenticity boundary, trust-entry parser and scope checks, prove their decision soundness, and obtain operational trust receipts separately.

obligations.title: Source reproduction and current equality
obligations.precise_goal: Prove selected historical normalization/hash computations operate on exact resolved artifacts, compare both ordered commitments, and keep current canonical-source equality as a distinct predicate backed by independently authenticated immutable identity.
obligations.gap: No concrete companion artifact/hash-profile resolver, formal SHA256 implementation bridge or current-companion-source proof is supplied. Hash equality is not an unconditional proof of source equality. The older PDF v156 source-unavailability statement is historical: selected historical v156 commitments have now been freshly reproduced successfully, as pinned in this assessment. Their universal-pair.production.v1 profile remains distinct from numina.pair-binding.v1.
obligations.next_action: Preserve completed selected historical commitment reproduction; obtain exact artifacts for the actual companion target, prove normalization/digest/resolver correspondence and independent current-source identity. State collision resistance only as an explicit computational assumption where required.

obligations.title: Authenticated revision/replay/conflict lifecycle
obligations.precise_goal: Instantiate current-state authority and transition system; prove predecessor links, monotonic update rules, revocation, same-revision conflict preservation, cache-age rules and stale/rollback/fork rejection; acceptance requires authenticated current binding/revision/payload digest.
obligations.gap: Only generic proof-carrying refinement and an integer-counter example exist. A timestamp or predecessor digest alone cannot establish current branch. No actual NCPS state-to-runtime refinement witness exists.
obligations.next_action: Define concrete binding/journal state and transitions, prove initialization/step simulation and inductive invariants, then test concurrency/recovery under the exact implementation. Specify fairness/progress separately for any liveness claim.

obligations.title: Authorized private mapping semantics
obligations.precise_goal: Prove permitted opaque references resolve only through an authenticated authorized mapping/version and missing/denied evidence remains unverified; public input cannot choose arbitrary resolver locations.
obligations.gap: Recovered model only checks a privateResolution flag. No authenticated resolver/mapping implementation or receipt is recovered. Mapping association does not prove inverse genesis derivation or unique common origin.
obligations.next_action: Specify resolver interface/access-control/output evidence and prove decision behavior under supplied authenticated mapping, then obtain authorized operational mapping evidence separately.

obligations.title: Structured verdicts, closure and failure dominance
obligations.precise_goal: Prove null signature yields unsigned pending, malformed/failing signature yields invalid, diagnostic findings remain distinct, failure dominates and unavailable/pending/blocked/crashed/incomplete never yields signed acceptance; every mandatory closure stage is Finished(Pass) for the pinned target.
obligations.gap: Modeled flags and FullProtocolPass conjunction do not demonstrate completion/soundness of actual check execution. The recovered report has seven rather than eight findings and closure statuses omit execution lifecycle states.
obligations.next_action: Define an executable structured result/lifecycle type and connect each check's actual semantics to a finding before proving aggregate soundness/completeness.

obligations.title: Actual executable/state refinement and source-to-binary linkage
obligations.precise_goal: Construct a refinement/conformance witness for the exact implementation and build; prove wire intake, validation, message construction, cryptography, evidence resolution and decision output agree with the exact specification, and resource failures preserve incomplete outcomes.
obligations.gap: Conforms and Refinement are supplied premises, not discharged implementation theorems. Existing repository release-envelope verification signs canonical{artifact_type,key_id,payload}; it must not be identified with the distinct NUMINA-PAIR-BINDING/V1 companion preimage.
obligations.next_action: Select actual companion implementation source/build, define semantics/adapters and prove each bridge. Pin native toolchain/binary/dependencies; independently validate without promoting sampled test agreement to universal proof.

obligations.title: Field deployment and reality correspondence
obligations.precise_goal: Obtain exact deployed source/build/environment/operator identities, actually accepted companion bytes, independent trust/current-state/resolver outputs, observed usage and revocation/recovery/failure receipts for a declared interval.
obligations.gap: No abstract theorem, signed manuscript, sourceZIP, succeeded metadata or website availability proves these live facts. These are evidence obligations, not custom Lean axioms.
obligations.next_action: Conduct authorized operational validation with reproducible receipts after the concrete protocol has been implemented and approved for the selected environment.

known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.claim: An extensional extraction set uniquely identifies an ordered pair.
known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.result: False; fresh Lean counterexample verifies order loss. The manuscript already discloses this and uses ordered occurrences for recovery.

known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.claim: SHA256 equality universally implies equality of arbitrary source byte sequences.
known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.result: False as an unconditional injectivity statement for unbounded inputs and fixed-size output. Use exact bytes or state a bounded/computational collision-resistance premise.

known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.claim: A mathematically valid signature proves independent signer authorization or truth of signed attribution.
known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.result: Unsupported; recovered model itself proves a valid-signature/untrusted-authority report is not accepted.

known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.claim: Signed timestamp/predecessor identifies the latest/current branch.
known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.result: Unsupported without independently authenticated current-state and conflict/revocation policy.

known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.claim: FullProtocolPass fields set to pass establish actual whole protocol correctness.
known_impossible_or_invalid_strengthenin.result: A conjunction of asserted status values proves properties of that model only; actual check semantics and runtime refinement are separate obligations.

actionable_sequence.action: Recover exact pair-wire engineering packet via its existing Library locator and the remaining AppendixQ source/receipt packets; verify every printed hash and complete import graph.
Fix a complete explicit companion interpretation/profile and concrete eight-finding/lifecycle schema; define a target run/context/decision specification.
actionable_sequence.qualification: Definition alone is not proof of implementation correctness.

actionable_sequence.action: Prove concrete bounded intake, ordered payload mapping and canonical bytes; instantiate exact framed message. Compose existing roundtrip/injectivity lemmas using proved witnesses.
Discharge signature acceptance, trust, source commitments, replay/current-state and authorized resolver bridges with explicit independent-input assumptions and exact policy/binary boundaries.
Prove aggregate concrete decision soundness/completeness and implementation/state refinement; audit all dependencies and run independently justified interoperability/security validation.
Obtain real deployment/source/current-state/resolver/usage/failure-recovery receipts if a field-deployment claim is required.
actionable_sequence.qualification: Operational observation supports reality correspondence; it is separate from the formal correctness theorem.

overall_conclusion: Available sources support four additional bounded kernel-checked statements and a verified131-theorem abstract bundle. Actual whole-protocol soundness/completeness remains open because concrete semantics, exact distinct dependencies and implementation/refinement witnesses are absent. No new full-pass claim, custom axiom, signature or modification of frozen originals is made.
